description: Small summary dict for the Past Analyses run list: catalog size, candidate count, simple subset size, top archetype label, run duration.
docstring:
Extract a small headline summary from a RunReport.

Args:
    report: A RunReport (typically the same instance being assembled by load_run_report, before this function's own output is folded back into report.headline_metrics -- see RunReport's own note on this slight circularity, resolved by load_run_report computing this function's result BEFORE constructing the final RunReport and passing it in as the headline_metrics field).

Returns:
    {'catalog_size': int, 'candidate_count': int, 'simple_subset_size': int, 'top_archetype_label': str | None, 'top_opportunity_score': float | None, 'run_duration_seconds': float | None, 'status': str}. top_archetype_label/top_opportunity_score are None when opportunity_matrix is empty (no scored archetypes). run_duration_seconds is None when the run has not finished (finished_at is None).
postconditions: Never raises for a RunReport with empty frames; returns None for the fields that cannot be computed rather than raising or fabricating a value

edge_cases.input: A completed run with a well-formed opportunity_matrix

unit_tests.name: test_headline_metrics_for_completed_run
unit_tests.description: A fully populated fixture RunReport yields the expected top archetype and duration.
unit_tests.expected: matches the fixture's known top archetype and duration

unit_tests.name: test_headline_metrics_for_empty_opportunity_matrix
unit_tests.description: An empty opportunity_matrix yields None for both top-archetype fields without raising.
unit_tests.expected: top_archetype_label is None, top_opportunity_score is None

unit_tests.name: test_headline_metrics_for_unfinished_run
unit_tests.description: A run with finished_at=None yields run_duration_seconds=None.
